proposals.evidence: DEDR 990 explicitly groups the one numeral: (a) Tamil oru, Kannada obba, Kui ro, Kurux ort and Brahui asiṭ; (b) Telugu okaṭi, Kolami okkod and Gadaba ukuṭ; (c) Kurux oṇṭā; (d) Tamil oṉṟu/oṇṇu, Kannada ondu, Tulu oñji, Gondi undi and Kurux ōnd. The selected simple survey responses fit the corresponding branch; composite and divergent responses remain unassigned. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These selected southern survey forms fit the cinna family; Gondi and Kurux lookalikes require separate contact evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
